protocol.alignment: Independent estimate-to-reference Sim(3) fit to the same sparse training IDs per condition
protocol.ate: Camera-center RMSE in scene-specific reference trajectory units
protocol.rpe: Consecutive common sequence frames after Sim(3). Compare inverse(T_i) @ T_j. Translation in reference units and rotation geodesic in degrees.
protocol.focal: Estimated-to-reference fx and fy ratios and absolute errors on the prepared image grid
protocol.coverage: Archived same-checkpoint accumulated alpha support on the frozen held-out pixels
protocol.reference_usage: Only evaluate geometric accuracy and verify reference consistency. Track reprojection uses estimated cameras and train RGB.
